svg.title: its-my-claude: a Claude Code config that learns from its own mistakes
svg.desc: A pixel workshop. A bookshelf holds 67 rules beside a provenance cabinet whose trail leads to a book that opens. A pegboard holds 82 skill tools, and the agent walks over to take the hammer, then back to his desk where a mug sits and a thin orange cat strolls. A hanging orrery has CLAUDE.md at its centre. The dream engine sleeps in a bed under a night window, dreaming of insights.md. A hook guard at the door to tool calls stops a crate marked rm, then a crate marked with two ampersands, until each is fixed.
svg.text: a Claude Code config that learns from its own mistakes
